title: Battle Cats Clash
description: Deploy bizarre, lovable cat warriors from your home tower to push across the lane, smash quirky enemy waves, and topple the rival fortress.
controls: Tap cat unit icons as your funds refill to summon squads and fire your base cannon at enemy lines.

zh-CN.title: 猫咪大作战
zh-CN.description: 魔性横版推塔猫咪大作战：召唤各具奇葩绝技的萌猫大军出击对推，攒能量放基地大炮一举推翻敌方堡垒！
zh-CN.controls: 随资金增长点击召唤不同兵种的猫咪出击推线，击破敌方基地即可获胜。
